how: The suggestions record, written by tools/suggest_ledger.js in the job and held by tools/suggest_check.js. night (since 7 November 2026, the owner's call): each night's one set on the Suggested Parlays tab, across every game of the night (the first Eastern date with a game to tip, never preseason), its team legs (moneyline, spread, total, at DraftKings' prices in lines.json and the builder's chance, 45% to 97%, none far off DraftKings, no value bar) and, on every set the page with player legs takes from 23:00 UTC on 7 November 2026, DraftKings' main lines on players (over and under, both prices, at DraftKings' own fair chance, never the props model's, 45% to 97%, none on a player the report lists or the props model does not place in the game), one side, one total and one leg a player a game: from 2026-11-08T18:00:00Z (the owner's call of 8 November 2026) each level the likeliest parlay of 2 legs or more, no leg limit, paying its floor on $1, Safe $2, Medium $4, Aggressive $8; before it Safe the likeliest 2-leg parlay, Medium the likeliest of 2 to 5 legs paying $4 or more, Aggressive the likeliest of 2 to 5 paying $8 or more; from 2026-11-10T18:00:00Z (the owner's call of 10 November 2026) each level the likeliest such parlay holding at least one player leg wherever the pool makes one, else the likeliest without one, saying why (nopl: lines, no player line read; fit, none that makes the level), its levels' heads carrying need: player; by the builder's own sums; keyed season|date|first tip|<season>_<date>_NIGHT, its pool kept beside it (every team leg's key, price and chance, each game's side and total together, and the player legs and games' legs together that come within 1% of a level's chance: pl counts the player lines read, out of the band, held out and cut) so the check works every level out again, rewritten while the night's lock (2 hours before its first tip-off) is to come and locked from it (held so though its first tip-off moves later; no set is taken of a night DraftKings has posted no line for); from the lock to the first tip-off a level holding a player the report has since listed is built again, that level alone, on its own pool, and recorded in updates; graded leg by leg as its games finish. night_summary: per level, as below (its exp_model the wins expected by each level's own chance, the one it was ranked on: the model's on team legs, DraftKings' fair chance on player legs), from the night map alone. featured (until 7 November 2026): each game on national TV's three parlays on the Suggested Parlays tab (Safe, Medium, Aggressive, 2 to 4 legs from that game alone, every bet type; a player's chance is the props model's, on trial; a set taken by the page that drew four, before 2026-11-05T03:00:00Z or by a run of it that landed after, holds a fourth, Extreme, 5 legs, kept and graded as it was), taken from the published page on the state just published and DraftKings' lines in lines.json, keyed season|date|tip|game, rewritten while the set's lock (2 hours before tip-off) is to come and locked from it, so each entry is the set as the job last published it before the lock; from the lock to tip-off a level holding a player the injury report has since listed is built again, that level alone, and recorded in updates. From tip-off it is graded as a book settles it, by the page's own settlement (the scores, and each player's box line: a player with none did not play, void): a leg lost loses; a push or void leg drops out and the rest are paid at the builder's price on the legs left; every leg a push or void is a push, the stake back; the payout on a $1 stake. featured_summary: per level, the parlays graded won or lost (each season's game and level once), won, the wins expected by DraftKings' fair chance and by the model's, and units on $1, Extreme's from the sets that hold it (taken by the page that drew four: before 2026-11-05T03:00:00Z, or by a run of it that landed after), kept as history. Never edited by hand: the check refuses a ledger whose locked entries moved.
